summary: Full regression on FastAPI-migrated SecureBank. Backend 26/27 pytest passes; frontend flows (login, dashboard, banking, transactions filter, beneficiaries via API, profile update, admin console, RBAC, unauth redirect) all work. One functional bug: deposit >=100000 is scored as MEDIUM instead of HIGH, contradicting the fraud-detection spec.

minor.issue: assess_risk() gives score=3 for amount>=100000 (needs >=4 for HIGH), so a plain 1,20,000 deposit returns riskLevel=MEDIUM. Spec says '>=100000 HIGH'. Bump the >=100000 branch to score+=4 (or level='HIGH' directly).

integration_issues.issue: Large deposits of 1,50,000 show a MEDIUM badge instead of HIGH in the result panel — mirrors backend bug above.

issues: 'Deposit / Withdraw / Transfer' link label is truncated to 'Deposit / Withdraw / Tra...' on 1920px viewport — consider wider sidebar or shorter label like 'Banking'.

action_items: Fix assess_risk() so amount>=100000 alone => HIGH (currently only MEDIUM). Options: score+=4 in that branch, or short-circuit level='HIGH'.
Optional: shorten sidebar label 'Deposit / Withdraw / Transfer' to avoid truncation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py assess_risk() thresholds don't match the documented fraud spec; unit-test HIGH threshold.
CORS is configured with allow_credentials=False and allow_origins from env — OK for JWT-in-header, but confirm production CORS_ORIGINS is set (defaults to '*').
Startup uses @app.on_event('startup') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.
seed_data_creation: Registered a few TEST_* users via API for transfer/beneficiary/suspend flows; profile of demo user updated (phone 8888888888, address 'TEST addr').
test_credentials: Admin kanamkhushikumari1@gmail.com/Admin@12345, Demo demo@securebank.com/User@12345 — both work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has been rewritten for FastAPI (uses response['message'] error shape and Bearer token). Only one failing test: TestBanking::test_deposit_high_risk — asserts riskLevel=='HIGH' for a 120000 deposit; fails because assess_risk scoring caps at MEDIUM. After the main agent fixes the threshold, re-run pytest and verify the deposit result banner in /banking also shows a HIGH badge.
rca_of_the_issue: In server.py assess_risk(): amount>=100000 adds score 3, and level='HIGH' requires score>=4. So a large-but-otherwise-clean deposit reaches only MEDIUM. Spec ('>=50000 MEDIUM, >=100000 HIGH') and seed data (force_risk='HIGH' for the 1,50,000 demo txn) both indicate the intent is HIGH for >=1,00,000. Fix: change 'score += 3' to 'score += 4' on that branch, or set level directly.
